scope: Starting point for functional composition and core reanalysis; does not rerun FASTQ mapping
count_unit: Uniquely assigned paired-end fragments; either or both mates may provide support; multilabel terms receive equal fractions
RPK_definition: assigned fragments * 1000 / reference nucleotide length, before functional aggregation
normalization: No genomic-equivalent correction. Full-layer relative abundances and per-million sensitivity are derived during analysis.
annotation_policy: All linked protein clusters must have the same nonempty annotation set in a layer; missing or conflicting units are excluded from that layer

read_policy.fragment_policy: union of both end candidate sets
read_policy.assignment: one count only for a singleton union; both-mate and single-mate support separate
read_policy.ambiguity: withheld; no fractional redistribution or EM
read_policy.interpretation: unique among reported passing candidates, not exhaustive biological uniqueness
read_policy.index: native minimap2 multipart -I4G with --split-prefix global candidate merge
read_policy.query_names: sample-global ordinal; unchanged by chunk subdivision or resume
read_policy.partition_limitation: Seeding and chaining occur per index part; equality with single-part mapping is not asserted.

upstream_audit.scope: Checks the transferred export and its numerical consistency; does not independently rerun read mapping, all sequence-to-annotation joins, or ecological tests.
